ms_struct.description: Market structure (EmperorBTC method): trade only with the daily and 4H structure; after a 4H break of structure wait for the pullback, enter on the 1H change of character back in trend direction; stop beyond the pullback extreme + 1 ATR, target the previous swing (min 2R), 1% risk; strong opposite news vetoes the entry

rel_value.description: Relative value, market-neutral: top-30 Hyperliquid coins by market cap; once a day go long the 5 strongest and short the 5 weakest over the last 7 days (equal dollars each side, keep a coin while it stays in the top/bottom 8). Skips coins whose move is extreme (more than 2 standard deviations from the pack): crashed coins tend to bounce violently

news_regime.description: News trading with regime switching: the AI news analyst decides whether and which way to trade; ADX trend/range regime sets the stop, target and holding time (ATR-scaled); never trades on technicals alone

ta_trend.description: TA trend: 4H Donchian breakout (close beyond the 200-candle / ~33-day high or low) when ADX confirms a trend; 2 ATR trailing stop, exit on the opposite breakout, 1% risk. Picked over 4H EMA crossovers by the backtest

watcher.description: Watcher (self-learning): records the conditions around every trade the four bots take (trend/range, with/against the daily structure, volatility, news, funding, session), learns which bot wins in which conditions, and copies their trades with more money (up to 1.5x) where they have an edge and less (down to 0.5x) where they don't. Starts as an equal split

momentum_3d.description: Trend: go with the last 3 days' direction

momentum_7d.description: Trend: go with the last 7 days' direction

crowd_follow.description: Positioning: go WITH the crowded side (funding far above baseline = longs paying = go long)

crowd_fade.description: Positioning: go AGAINST the crowded side (squeeze bet)

news.description: News: themes in the last 24h headlines, using measured reactions once learned

combo.description: Self-learning: weighted vote of the signals above, weights = their live win rate edge
